summary: Bonner County, ID lookout: 1923 cupola cabin, a 1930s L-4 tower, abandoned 1935; Idaho Fire Lookouts says the site is now an electronics site with nothing of the lookout left.

notes_for_editor: The dates agree on all four pages, but Forest Lookouts and WillhiteWeb credit them to Kresek and the other two give no source, so the agreement is less independent than it looks. Only Idaho Fire Lookouts describes the site today (an electronics site); no second source found. No staffing or fire history is sourced; the 1930 event year stands for 'the 1930s'. Gate status is seasonal and undated. Brief record has no errors found.
